global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a white bowl with black Greek-key trim, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy yellow, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough, uneven surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with glossy surface and irregular, slightly curled edges.
